iti27:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti27:2.1: yāni kānici bhikkhave opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni, sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ.
iti27:2.2: mettāyeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
iti27:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā, sabbā tā candimapabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā yeva tā adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca, tapate ca, virocati ca,
iti27:3.2: evaṃ kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni, sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ. mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
iti27:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake nabhe ādicconabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihaccabhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca,
iti27:4.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni, sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ. mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca, tapate ca, virocati ca.
iti27:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ osadhi tārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca,
iti27:5.2: eva meva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni, sabbāni tānimettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
iti27:11.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
